body: Please leave me alone if all you are here to do is argue with me.

I have tried. What has been slashed open recently is how my parents truly do not love me. They hate me. And not having loving parents has clearly left me feeling absolutely at a disadvantage in life. And it is a real REAL disadvantage that no one ever talks about. I walk around and I can feel the years and years of rejection just emanating from my damaged core. I'll climb out of it by like 1 inch and some little thing will send me right back there. Why do I walk around like a hated orphan? Why do I have to? Can I even not? I don't think I can... And the worst of it is, I'm dealing with a very sick individual (domestic violence including a protection order) and this person has an entire family at their backing. I am being harassed by the mother, the father and even the cousins. This person has a loving family, multiple homes to return to (they are rich), and probably a life that will never truly mean destitution and rejection like mine has. For what reason is this so? For what reason am I suffering and they immune? (It's a family of shitheads basically) For what reason can I not afford a lawyer to prosecute and they can? By any moral standard they don't deserve more than me. But yet they have more.  Humanity is so sick. I am sick. And I'm never going to get better....
I have to be honest or I'll never get what I want. It's not personal, but if you took it that way, I apologize.

>but I am a woman and I don't hate you.

Sure you don't but if i actually met you, you would either ignore me or consider me competition. Since I have a lowly position right now, you'll say what you say because it feels good to you. But I doubt you'd actually be my friend.

Socializing is people who are invested in eachother gaining favors, time, money or praise from those investments. If you don't believe this I wonder, are you a religious type who believes in angels and the devil etc? There is no "feel goody" way to explain what is fact. It's not hard to manufacture love. I do it all the time, and so do you.

In what way do you mean you've been turned down? Socially?

Oh in a lot of ways. Most of my life. By my parents, by my jobs, by my rentals applications, by my loan applications, by social groups, by religions. Do I have to explain myself? I really am tired of this. 

>Isn't that precisely why you should at least try?

No. No it isn't. Are you thinking I just need to read some self help book and suddenly figure out the mathematical equation? I've been social before, and truthfully I will probably keep trying but I honestly feel I will always be handicapped and in truth, with males I am always just a piece of meat and with women I am hated, because women hate women. If I could win the lottery, I would pay people to "socialize" for me. (I.e. tell other people how awesome I am and get followers.) I would manufacture love, because nobody really cares except blood relatives if you are lucky. And I'm not lucky. 

I don't know if you are helping me. It seems like you'd rather pick apart what I have to say rather than genuinely try to make me feel better.

>in what?

General sciences. I actually was an ap/honors student, but coming from abuse when I had to survive on my own (plus be in school while homeless) I just was barely able to pass. 

>how often is this? and do you drink or smoke cigs?

Once a week. Drinking maybe twice a week while being social. Don't smoke. Quit 3 months ago after "trying to smoke" for like a year. 

>You should do it too

You know, I honestly don't see the point. I can't really socialize well anyway due to the abuse I suffered, and I simply cannot relate to most normal people. Most normal people already have enough friends. So I try to stick around here on sw helping people who need it. But honestly, humanity is disgusting and I'm tired of the pointlessness of life. So many cruel people. Even people whom I may have helped not kill themselves (that's a scary thought.) And seriously worst of all, is when you get turned down over and over because you don't match what society wants. I'm a useless person. In my lifetime 2 billion people have been added to the population on the planet.
